findings.highlight: the tension between the two has disappeared
findings.evidenceJa: 二人の間にあった緊張感は薄れている
findings.governingReading: The tension between Sakura and Rin has faded on the surface.
findings.explanation: Disappeared overstates a partial, explicitly superficial easing as complete resolution.

findings.highlight: other things like the fried eggs
findings.evidenceJa: 卵焼き等のおかず軍団
findings.governingReading: Sakura lays out miso soup, tamagoyaki, and the rest of the breakfast dishes.
findings.explanation: Fried eggs substitutes a different dish for rolled omelet.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what’s bothering her, but she glares at me and picks up her chopsticks.
findings.evidenceJa: 用意されたものは食べるわ。当然の礼儀でしょう、それって
findings.governingReading: Rin says eating food already prepared is basic courtesy.
findings.explanation: The English inserts irritation, a glare, and taking up chopsticks absent from the active Japanese page.

findings.highlight: What kind of king are you
findings.evidenceJa: どこの王侯貴族なんだか
findings.governingReading: Rin sarcastically asks what royal aristocrat has a junior make his breakfast.
findings.explanation: King narrows the compound social image and changes the teasing accusation.

findings.highlight: just eat breakfast for now
findings.evidenceJa: 三者三様のていでお辞儀をして
findings.governingReading: The three each bow in their own fashion before breakfast begins.
findings.explanation: The entire three-way gesture and its characterization disappear.

findings.highlight: Gah. No conversation.
findings.evidenceJa: いかんな。どうも会話がない
findings.governingReading: A long, progressively extended silence passes before Shirou notices the absence of conversation.
findings.explanation: Gah replaces the timed silence and destroys the delayed comic realization.

findings.highlight: I forcefully make myself understand.
findings.evidenceJa: 無理矢理納得して飯をかっこむ
findings.governingReading: Shirou forces himself to accept the excuse and shovels down his food.
findings.explanation: The physical eating action disappears, weakening the transition into Taiga’s arrival.

findings.highlight: Fuji-nee sits Japanese-style in her usual seat.
findings.evidenceJa: いつもの席に正座する藤ねえ
findings.governingReading: Taiga sits in seiza at her usual place.
findings.explanation: A precise posture becomes a vague ethnicized description.

findings.highlight: The two’s greetings are in strange unison.
findings.evidenceJa: おそろしいほどユニゾンする二人の挨拶
findings.governingReading: Sakura and Rin greet Taiga in unnervingly perfect unison.
findings.explanation: The two’s is malformed, while strange weakens the almost frightening synchronicity.

findings.highlight: takes a sip of her miso soup
findings.evidenceJa: みそ汁を飲み干す藤ねえ
findings.governingReading: Taiga drains her miso soup before the delayed realization detonates.
findings.explanation: A sip reverses the scale and removes the complete-action timing that structures the joke.

findings.highlight: Sakura is on the other side
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は風上
findings.governingReading: Sakura is safely upwind when the table overturns.
findings.explanation: Other side removes the directional reason Sakura escapes the spill.

findings.highlight: food cooked in pot
findings.evidenceJa: つくね煮込んだ鍋もの
findings.governingReading: The overturned breakfast includes a hotpot with simmered tsukune.
findings.explanation: The generic phrase erases both the dish and the meatball ingredient.

findings.highlight: It’ll be hot if you spill that on mehey, why are we having food in a pot for breakfast
findings.evidenceJa: 熱いだろうって、何故に朝っぱらから鍋物なぞ
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s burn complaint pivots into disbelief about hotpot at breakfast.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses me and hey.

findings.highlight: letting a girl stay over
findings.evidenceJa: 同い年の女の子を下宿させるなんて
findings.governingReading: Taiga objects specifically to Shirou housing a girl his own age.
findings.explanation: The age parity driving her concern is omitted.

findings.highlight: No, it’s not even funny!
findings.evidenceJa: わたしゃそんな質の悪い冗談じゃ笑ってやらない
findings.governingReading: Taiga refuses to laugh at such a tasteless, poor-quality joke.
findings.explanation: The English drops her judgment of the joke’s quality and performed refusal.

findings.highlight: a piece of chicken fell in my shirt
findings.evidenceJa: 襟元からつくねが
findings.governingReading: A tsukune meatball has fallen inside Shirou’s collar.
findings.explanation: The specific meatball becomes generic chicken and the collar becomes the broader shirt.

findings.highlight: a hot one too
findings.evidenceJa: 必要以上に加熱されたつくね
findings.governingReading: Shirou comically specifies that the tsukune is heated more than necessary.
findings.explanation: Hot one drops the exaggerated redundancy that delivers the punchline.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka, who was only watching from a distance, comes to stand directly beside Fuji-nee.
findings.evidenceJa: ガクガクと頭を振られながら呟く
findings.governingReading: Still being shaken, Shirou mutters his appeal to Rin.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a complete blocking action for Rin absent from the active Japanese.

findings.highlight: As a teacher and as Shirou’s guardian
findings.evidenceJa: 教師として、なにより士郎の教育係として
findings.governingReading: Taiga invokes her authority as teacher and, above all, Shirou’s educational supervisor.
findings.explanation: Guardian broadens the specific role she invokes in this school-coded argument.

findings.highlight: It must be her natural instincts.
findings.evidenceJa: 野生の勘というヤツだろう
findings.governingReading: Shirou jokingly credits Taiga’s animal or wild instinct.
findings.explanation: Natural instincts removes the comic animalization.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka would get her
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に寝首をかかれる
findings.governingReading: Taiga senses that Rin will cut her throat in her sleep if she remains distracted.
findings.explanation: Get her erases the vivid mock-combat idiom.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s answer and attitude are so student-like
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の返答と態度があんまりにも優等生
findings.governingReading: Rin’s answer and demeanor are impeccably those of a model student.
findings.explanation: Student-like loses the exceptional, strategic performance that silences the teacher.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what could happen if the two of you stay under one roof.
findings.evidenceJa: 一つ屋根の下で暮らす、というのはどうかと思う
findings.governingReading: Taiga says she questions a boy and girl living beneath one roof.
findings.explanation: What could happen adds a predictive sexualized implication before her deliberately hesitant “mistake” wording.

findings.highlight: There are lots of things to follow up
findings.evidenceJa: まだ色々とつっこみどころはある
findings.governingReading: Shirou sees many holes or points still open to challenge in Rin’s argument.
findings.explanation: Follow up sounds like pending tasks rather than weaknesses in her case.

findings.highlight: officially has citizenship in my house
findings.evidenceJa: うちの市民権を獲得できた
findings.governingReading: Rin has, figuratively, won recognized standing in the Emiya household.
findings.explanation: Officially pushes the citizenship joke toward literal legal status.

findings.highlight: have Fuji-nee look after us at home
findings.evidenceJa: 家では藤ねえが監督する
findings.governingReading: The condition is that Taiga supervises the household arrangement.
findings.explanation: Look after us turns oversight of cohabitation into general caretaking.

findings.highlight: Please consider me necessary when you are in danger.
findings.evidenceJa: 危険が迫った時は私を必要としてください
findings.governingReading: If danger approaches, Shirou should actively need or call for Saber, allowing her to sense his abnormal state.
findings.explanation: Consider me necessary is Japanese-shaped and weakens the intentional signal into an opinion.

findings.highlight: That will allow me to feel Master’s danger.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターの異状は感じ取れます
findings.governingReading: Saber can sense an abnormality in her Master when he reaches for her.
findings.explanation: Danger replaces the broader detectable change in Shirou’s condition and makes the mechanism circular.
